name: Orchid Pharma Ltd
title: Orchid Pharma Ltd - 524372 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue flat at INR238 crores and EBITDA INR42.3 crores, with margins recovering as cephalosporin price erosion eased; FY26 EBITDA fell to INR101 crores from INR155 crores, and management guides base-business margin of about 12%.

triggers.label: Pricing up in April on war
triggers.quote: you see the pricing did increase in the month of April, due to the war
triggers.highlight: pricing did increase in the month of April

triggers.label: Q2-Q3 gross margins 31-32%, then Q4 recovery
triggers.quote: Our Q2, Q3 gross margins were around 31%, 32%. So here we were carrying high price inventory
triggers.highlight: Our Q2, Q3 gross margins were around 31%, 32%

triggers.label: Base business growth 10-15% in FY27
triggers.quote: we hope we can continue between 10% to 15% again this year. That's our target.
triggers.highlight: we hope we can continue between 10% to 15% again this year

triggers.label: 7ACA price ~$61, stable
triggers.quote: same price currently, it's around $61. Long-term average is $60. So stable

guidance.quote: we are targeting something around that
we hope we can continue between 10% to 15% again this year. That's our target.
We are still committed to the commissioning in the first quarter of calendar year 2027.

guidance.value: Q2 or Q3 CY2027, subject to approvals
guidance.quote: we expect product launch during Q2 or Q3 of calendar year 2027

guidance.value: one announcement per quarter; about 50% signed in six months
guidance.quote: I would say 50% will be signed in for sure.

prior_guidance_check.metric: US Enmetazobactam deal expected this year
prior_guidance_check.quote: we hope at least the discussions are in advanced stages that they would be closed in this quarter, coming quarter, at least.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Enmetazobactam peak in about three years
prior_guidance_check.quote: the peak should be reaching fourth or fifth year of the launch, not three years.

red_flags.label: Enmetazobactam licensing deals slipping
red_flags.quote: unfortunately, we don't have the definitive agreement signed yet.

red_flags.label: Peak sales timeline pushed out
red_flags.quote: the peak should be reaching fourth or fifth year of the launch, not three years.

red_flags.label: Dhanuka financials unaudited
red_flags.quote: EBITDA numbers, I don't have at this point of time. The audit is going on.
